actions.description: Actions, in the order the action manifest lists them.

predicates.description: The proposition vocabulary: each predicate and the generic detector that computes it.

description: One rules file. A world may load several; their sections are merged by name.
title: RulesFile

actuator.description: The actuator the action belongs to. An agent without the actuator lacks the action.

duration.description: Maximum duration in simulated seconds. Absent with no `until`: instantaneous.

until.description: Ends the action early when all of these hold. Checked every tick.

energy_cost.description: Energy cost, 0 in milestone 1: fatigue carries the cost of activity instead.

sound.description:
A sound event the action emits. Parsed for the contract's format; ears are not in
milestone 1, so no sound is produced.

ActionSpec.description:
One action type (contract 2, addition A3, addition A4).

An action is durative when it has a `duration` or an `until` condition. Its `effects`
apply when the action completes; rate effects among them apply every tick while the action
lasts. `on_start` applies when the action starts, and `on_end` when the action ends for
any reason, completion or interruption, after `effects`. An action whose effect cannot be
written as data names a registered rule `module` and passes it `params`.

has.description: For a target slot: the tag the target must carry.

optional.description:
For a target slot: whether the target may be left out, in which case the nearest
qualifying entity in front of the agent is used.

ArgSlot.description:
One argument slot of an action: a continuous range, or a target.

Written as `{range: [lo, hi], units: rad}` for a continuous argument, or as
`{has: edible, optional: true}` for a target that must carry a tag.

PredicateCall.description: A call to a registered predicate, such as `within(self, target, 1.0)`.

Effect.description: A call to a registered effect: a mapping with one key, the effect name, whose value maps argument names to arguments.

RuleArgument.description: A literal number or boolean, a bare symbol, or a reference: self, target, or this, optionally followed by a field path and optionally preceded by a minus sign.

Trait_for_double.description: A trait: either a bare value, or a mapping with `default` and optional `range`, `units`, `variation`, `heritable`, `mutable`, and `visible`. Without `range`, the range is the default alone.

TraitFull.description:
The full, written-out form of a trait. `range` may be left out, in which case the range is
the default value alone, as in the bare-value shorthand.

oneOf.description: Normal distribution centered on the default, with standard deviation `sd`.

Uniform distribution centered on the default, from `default - half_width` to
`default + half_width`.

Variation.description: How individuals vary when sampled. Sampled values are clipped to the trait's range.

SoundSpec.description: A sound event an action emits.

every.description: Period in simulated seconds, counted per entity from the start of the run.

ProcessSpec.description: Something that happens in the world without any action, on a schedule (contract 2).

Selector.description: Selects the entities a process applies to: those carrying a tag.

args.description: Argument names, in PDDL order. A trailing numeric argument makes a fluent.

detector.description: The registered detector that computes the predicate.

PredicateSpec.description: One predicate of the proposition vocabulary (contract 5), computed by a named detector.
